attempts.prompt:
Create ONE finished graphic-novel cover for SOLSTICE EVENING BELL. Portrait 9:16, target 864 x 1536 pixels. This is a single cover image, not a comic page, collage or character sheet.

REFERENCE IMAGE 1 ROLE: use the attached original cover ONLY for the adult woman's facial identity, long silver hair, white armored dress and segmented silver-armor inspiration. Do not copy its composition, painterly rendering, lettering, giant spaceships, ornate fantasy coast, luminous web, apparent bell count, head tiara or external chest jewel. Redraw the entire scene in the precise comic rendering described below. The factual description below controls any conflict with the reference.

STYLE: crisp confident BLACK INK contours, heavier outer silhouettes, broad SATURATED FLAT COLOR fills, clean HARD-EDGED shadows in only a few tonal steps, clear stylized adult anatomy and expressive face. Graphic, forceful and readable. Near-black ink #11151B; midnight #102B56; strong storm blue #196FB4; restrained cyan #22A9C7; silver #C9DBE6; near-white #FFFDF4; pale-yellow #FFE783 used sparingly in the title treatment. Keep natural skin color. No watercolor, soft painted modeling, dense hatching, paper texture, grain, photorealism, glossy 3D, gradients across faces or copied ornate lettering.

STORY MOMENT: the opening invasion above an evacuated modern-like western bay at night, before Solstice attacks. One adult woman is the sole living defender. She is clean, dry and uninjured. There are no helpers, donor spirits or living donor women. Solstice is suspended in the air above the bay, rather than standing on a rock or on water. Show a powerful readable three-quarter portrait with enough of her armored body and flowing white dress to make the silhouette unmistakable. Her face turns upward toward the host with steady resolve; both armored hands begin to rise. Her long silver hair moves in the high air. Preserve the white armored dress, articulated silver-and-white bodice, silver pauldrons, segmented forearm and hand armor. Opaque armor fully covers the sternum. NO head crown or tiara. NO external chest gem. NO visible central jewel or floating chest object.

CRITICAL CHIME COUNT: exactly TWELVE intact separate silver bell-like chimes form a loose elongated orbital halo around Solstice. Stage SIX clearly separated chimes on the left and SIX on the right at staggered heights; each is fully visible and individually countable, none hidden by hair, figure, frame or lettering. One of the twelve is slightly smaller. These are nonliving equipment, not souls or tiny people. Do not add decorative extra bells anywhere. The thirteenth tone belongs to her thumb-sized CENTRAL RESONATOR, which is completely HIDDEN beneath her sternum armor: it is not a thirteenth orbiting chime and must not be visible. No broken chimes, no burnt silver, no wounds. No luminous net or geometric energy lattice. No attack beam: the opening chord has not happened yet.

INVASION AND PLACE: one stationary black seam very far above the bay in the starry sky, with EIGHT distinct descending wedge formations. Each wedge is made of many tiny separate roughly HUMAN-SIZED, featureless nonliving machine shells with FOLDING VANES. Render the host as dense formations of small individual silhouettes separated by air, not eight solid triangular vessels. No giant capital ships, airplane wings, cockpit windows, pilots or living monsters. Their small apparent size and the vast sky communicate distance; do not put an enormous close machine beside the woman. Beneath her is an evacuated modern-like bay with simple concrete northern breakwater at image left and southern breakwater at image right, offshore shallow sea shelf between their approaches, empty harbor roads and a distant eastern ridge on the far horizon. Black autumn cloud towers below the high fight, one night sky. No fantasy towers or ornate palaces, no crowds, no allied aircraft, no batteries, no rescue force. Keep the coastal forms subordinate to the clear figure and title.

COMPOSITION AND LETTERING: design one strong heroic silhouette and a clearly countable twelve-chime halo, with the eight distant wedge formations and seam above. Reserve an uncluttered dark title field low on the cover. Title is the ONLY readable text, exactly these two lines:
SOLSTICE
EVENING BELL
Use very readable bold condensed UPPERCASE comic lettering, near-white with a strong black outline and a restrained pale-yellow accent, approximately 96-112 px letter height at 864 px canvas width. Keep every title letter inside a minimum 48 px safe outer margin. Do not cover her face, hands, any chime or essential armor with text. Do not copy the original cover's fine serif typography. No subtitle, author name, credits, issue number, publisher mark, watermark, logo, speech balloons, caption boxes or sheet headings. Keep the figure, all twelve chimes and complete title within the final 9:16 portrait; do not crop them.
